lines.tts: Hi! We're Group 14, Team Sweet Potatoes.
lines.sub: Hi! We're Group 14, Team Sweet Potatoes.

lines.tts: We studied how international residents in Melbourne take part in council decisions.
lines.sub: We studied how international residents in Melbourne take part in council decisions.

lines.tts: Our investigation found five problems.
lines.sub: Our investigation found five problems.

lines.tts: One: even when it's translated, council language is hard to understand.
lines.sub: One: even when it's translated, council language is hard to understand.

lines.tts: Two: time, distance and fees keep people from attending.
lines.sub: Two: time, distance and fees keep people from attending.

lines.tts: Three: people only take part when an issue feels personally relevant.
lines.sub: Three: people only take part when an issue feels personally relevant.

lines.tts: Four: they don't know which department to contact, or whether they were heard.
lines.sub: Four: they don't know which department to contact, or whether they were heard.

lines.tts: Five: council news arrives by mail and flyers, but newer residents live on Instagram.
lines.sub: Five: council news arrives by mail and flyers, but newer residents live on Instagram.

lines.tts: Let's meet Jason.
lines.sub: Let's meet Jason.

lines.tts: He's 34, has lived in Melbourne for eight years, and English isn't his first language.
lines.sub: He's 34, has lived in Melbourne for eight years, and English isn't his first language.

lines.tts: One Saturday morning, a new park rule limits when his dog can be off the leash.
lines.sub: One Saturday morning, a new park rule limits when his dog can be off the leash.

lines.tts: He disagrees, but doesn't know who to tell, or which words to use.
lines.sub: He disagrees, but doesn't know who to tell, or which words to use.

lines.tts: So we introduce HearHere: a digital device that combines a physical information pillar with an AI customised helper.
lines.sub: So we introduce HearHere: a digital device that combines a physical information pillar with an AI customised helper.

lines.tts: Hi there! I'm Spud, the Street Post for Understanding Decisions.
lines.sub: Hi there! I'm Spud, the Street Post for Understanding Decisions.

lines.tts: Here's the post from every side.
lines.sub: Here's the post from every side.

lines.tts: It connects three channels. Spud's official account shares only verified council posts, where residents already scroll.
lines.sub: It connects three channels. Spud's official account shares only verified council posts, where residents already scroll.

lines.tts: An AI agent answers questions, and the HearHere app tracks each issue.
lines.sub: An AI agent answers questions, and the HearHere app tracks each issue.

lines.tts: Back to Saturday, 8 a.m. Jason walks his dog past a HearHere post.
lines.sub: Back to Saturday, 8 a.m. Jason walks his dog past a HearHere post.

lines.tts: Its pillar shows verified council and community notices.
lines.sub: Its pillar shows verified council and community notices.

lines.tts: Hi! Got something to say? I'm all ears.
lines.sub: Hi! Got something to say? I'm all ears.

lines.tts: The screen under Spud lists nearby issues by distance, including a new rule for the park next door.
lines.sub: The screen under Spud lists nearby issues by distance, including a new rule for the park next door.

lines.tts: Jason taps the park issue.
lines.sub: Jason taps the park issue.

lines.tts: A plain-language summary appears in his own language, with difficult terms explained.
lines.sub: A plain-language summary appears in his own language, with difficult terms explained.

lines.tts: Now he simply talks to Spud, in his own language.
lines.sub: Now he simply talks to Spud, in his own language.

lines.tts: 新的公園規定讓遛狗變得很不方便，我希望可以重新考慮。
lines.sub: The new park rule makes walking my dog really inconvenient. I hope it can be reconsidered.

lines.tts: Spud turns it into a clear English comment, names the responsible department, and lets Jason edit before sending.
lines.sub: Spud turns it into a clear English comment, names the responsible department, and lets Jason edit before sending.

lines.tts: No audio is stored.
lines.sub: No audio is stored.

lines.tts: Jason taps his phone on the N F C pad.
lines.sub: Jason taps his phone on the NFC pad.

lines.tts: The issue and his comment move to the HearHere app, and the post keeps nothing.
lines.sub: The issue and his comment move to the HearHere app, and the post keeps nothing.

lines.tts: Tracking begins only because Jason chose it.
lines.sub: Tracking begins only because Jason chose it.

lines.tts: The app shows each stage: Received, In review, then an outcome with a case number, or reasons if declined.
lines.sub: The app shows each stage: Received, In review, then an outcome with a case number, or reasons if declined.

lines.tts: Each new HearHere post Jason visits also earns a badge: a small reward for taking part.
lines.sub: Each new HearHere post Jason visits also earns a badge: a small reward for taking part.

lines.tts: Jason can also share the issue as a card on Instagram, so his neighbours can join in.
lines.sub: Jason can also share the issue as a card on Instagram, so his neighbours can join in.

lines.tts: For Jason, that means relevant issues on his route, in his own language, a clear department, and visible progress.
lines.sub: For Jason, that means relevant issues on his route, in his own language, a clear department, and visible progress.

lines.tts: All without attending a meeting.
lines.sub: All without attending a meeting.

lines.tts: HearHere has limits.
lines.sub: HearHere has limits.

lines.tts: Speaking in public may feel exposing, AI can mistranslate, and our fieldwork didn't include council staff.
lines.sub: Speaking in public may feel exposing, AI can mistranslate, and our fieldwork didn't include council staff.

lines.tts: Next, we'll test a low-fidelity prototype with residents across languages.
lines.sub: Next, we'll test a low-fidelity prototype with residents across languages.

lines.sub: HearHere, with Spud: the Street Post for Understanding Decisions.
